title: Being affine descends along fpqc coverings (Stacks 02L5)
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $\{g_i:S_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ be an fpqc covering of $S$ [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. For $i\in I$ let $f_i:X\times_SS_i\to S_i$ be the base change of $f$ along $g_i$, the second projection of the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]. If $f_i$ is affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism] for every $i\in I$, then $f$ is affine.

Its proof uses qcqs descent, flat base change of global sections, and descent of the canonical map to Spec of global sections; it has no sorry.

The given fpqc precover generates a covering sieve by Precoverage.generate_mem_toGrothendieck. Apply the proved source-library theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.of_isPullback_of_ofArrows_mem_fpqcTopology (WeilConjectures.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Sites.Fpqc) with P = IsAffineHom, the canonical pullback projections, and IsPullback.of_hasPullback. Mathlib supplies Zariski locality and stability under base change of IsAffineHom; the hypotheses supply affineness of the second projections. The theorem gives IsAffineHom f for arbitrary index universe, including an empty family over the empty base.
